answer_1.quote: Our evaluation framework spans six core capabilities of LLMs: Professional Knowledge, Common Sense Knowledge, Logical Reasoning, Reading Understanding, Multilingual Proficiency, and Code Generation, based on eight downstream evaluation benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code snippets and other model-generated sequences used for downstream benchmark evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the Perplexity (PPL) mode for the evaluation of the MMLU dataset... For the remaining benchmarks, we utilize the Generation (GEN) mode for evaluation... Regarding the programming task MBPP, we employ Python's built-in exec() function to verify the error‑free execution of the generated code.
